basis: Outer wall faces measured via gray-ink pixel profiles (west x=424,east x=1817,north y=346,south y=1086) calibrated to overall 15000x8000mm dimension lines. Interior walls represented as single centerline strokes at measured ink rows (corridor walls y=618 and y=815 pixels). North/south zones are open-plan (no full-height partition found between desk bays: pixel profile at the exterior wall row showed only a weak partial nib at x~883-920, not a continuous wall), so each is modeled as one open room reached via two doors from the corridor plus a south exterior entrance door and a west exterior corridor door found as gaps in the gray wall ink.
